column1: # inventory names for the fox-fur set (scripts/fox_fur_set.py)

column2: Fox-fur hat
A round cap of red fox fur with ties to knot under the chin. Not every fox the huntsman brings to Kuttenberg goes into the pot.
Fox-fur gloves
Gloves of fox fur, the red of the back and the pale of the belly sewn together. Warm, and a butcher's price for a word unsaid.

column1: # the Smelly debuff (Libs/Tables/rpg/buff__moonshine_names.xml): a bucket of guts for a bribe refused

column2: Smelly

Somebody emptied a bucket of offal over you, and a day of airing will not take the stink out. People keep their distance and think the less of you until it wears off; a wash will at least get the worst of it off your clothes.
Pitch torch
A torch with its head wound thick in tow and soaked in pitch. It throws its light twice as far as a common torch, and burns the faster for it.
Lantern
A horn-paned lantern of the kind the night watch carries. The flame is shielded from the wind and the light goes where it is pointed.
Pot of pitch
A flask of pitch thinned with tallow and spirits. Painted on a dozen arrowheads it catches from any flame and burns where it lands, and so does whoever is standing there.
Fire arrow
An arrow with its head wrapped in tow and soaked in pitch. Lit, it burns in the air and burns where it sticks.
Fire bolt
A crossbow bolt with its head wrapped in tow and soaked in pitch. Lit, it burns in the air and burns where it sticks.
Burning
Pitch is burning on you. Roll, or find water.
